document.title: Cloud & AI Industry Strategic Market Report 2026
document.body: In the Cloud Computing and Artificial Intelligence industry, top incumbents (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud) dominate enterprise infrastructure, while mid-tier challengers focus on developer niches. Under Backward Induction and Subgame Perfect Nash Equilibrium, new entrants maximize utility by adopting an Ecosystem Co-opetition and Niche Differentiation strategy rather than initiating a direct price war.
